voice: Liam - Energetic, Social Media Creator (Eleven v3)

clips.label: APP20 · PRODUCT OVERVIEW
clips.title: Private conversations. Clear trading terms.
clips.caption: Encrypted Chat, confidential escrow development, and the existing maker network.
clips.narration: APP twenty brings private conversations and trading to Starknet. Negotiate directly, or compare quotes from independent makers.

clips.label: CHAT · LOCALNET / MOCK PROVING
clips.title: Bob sends an encrypted message
clips.caption: Chat stays unlocked across app navigation in this tab. Lock or disconnect to clear access.
clips.narration: Bob opens Alice's conversation and sends an encrypted message. Chat stays unlocked as he moves around the app, so he can continue without repeating setup. This segment runs on localnet.

clips.label: CHAT · LOCALNET / MOCK PROVING
clips.title: Alice receives the message automatically
clips.caption: Chat fetches messages after unlocking, then every 60 seconds while visible and online.
clips.narration: Bob's message appears automatically for Alice. While Chat is unlocked, visible, and online, it checks for new messages every sixty seconds.

clips.label: CHAT · LOCALNET / MOCK PROVING
clips.title: Agree on a fixed offer in Chat
clips.caption: Set the amount, asset and expiry. Keep the offer attached to the conversation.
clips.narration: Alice attaches a fixed offer, with an amount, an asset, and an expiry. The terms stay with the conversation.

clips.label: CHAT · LOCALNET / MOCK PROVING
clips.title: Review the terms in context
clips.caption: Chat payments are separate from atomic RFQ settlement; payment alone does not guarantee the other asset.
clips.narration: Bob can review the offer in context. Chat payments are separate; an atomic exchange of both assets uses RFQ.

clips.label: CONFIDENTIAL RFQ · LOCALNET / SIMULATED PROOFS
clips.title: Agree on exact terms. Fund a shielded escrow.
clips.caption: Dedicated escrow · each party signs independently · separate encrypted funding.
clips.narration: Confidential RFQ takes a different route. Alice and Bob agree on exact terms and fund a shared escrow from their shielded balances. This is a local contract demonstration.

clips.label: CONFIDENTIAL RFQ · LOCALNET / SIMULATED PROOFS
clips.title: Both approvals. Both assets. One settlement.
clips.caption: Real local contracts with simulated proof facts. This does not establish mainnet or STARK-proof verification.
clips.narration: Each side funds separately. Both then approve the same operation, so both assets are delivered together as encrypted notes.

clips.label: CONFIDENTIAL RFQ · LOCALNET / SIMULATED PROOFS
clips.title: Recover independently when a trade expires
clips.caption: Alice’s STRK returns to Alice after the deadline. Bob’s signature is not required for her refund.
clips.narration: If Bob does not fund his side, Alice can recover her asset after the deadline. She does not need Bob to sign the refund.

clips.label: CONFIDENTIAL RFQ · DEVELOPMENT STATUS
clips.title: Private trade data, visible activity
clips.caption: Public shielding and unshielding still expose amounts. Hosted proving does not hide the witness from its provider.
clips.narration: In this local test, trade amounts and assets stay out of public settlement data. Activity and timing remain visible, and a hosted prover would see the private payload.

clips.label: PRODUCT PREVIEW · READ-ONLY
clips.title: The existing maker network
clips.caption: The current mainnet maker network uses the earlier RFQ protocol. Confidential maker integration is pending.
clips.narration: Anyone can become a maker. Register your public key, fund inventory, and run a bot with your pricing.

clips.label: PRODUCT PREVIEW · READ-ONLY
clips.title: Node SDK: separate signing and durable recovery
clips.caption: Development SDK · pinned contracts, private action review and recovery after an uncertain submission.
clips.narration: Agents can use the Node SDK directly, without the website. Signing stays with the agent's own wallet.
